facts.fact: The HIS profile (August 2019) answers 'population census within the last 10 years' with 'No (2007)', implying the last census was in 2007; the indicator is marked outdated.
The profile lists MICS5 (2014) as an available national health survey with data and reports on linked sites; release date not given, year of survey used.
The profile lists the DHS (2006-2007) as an available national health survey with data and reports on linked sites; release date not given, survey years used.
